summary: Humphreys County, TN tower listed as standing at 712 ft on one tower list, but absent from the 2014 Division of Forestry list of surviving towers; no history found.

corrections.why: The 2014 list of towers standing on March 26, 2014 has no Humphreys County entry, which conflicts with the tnlandforms standing mark; the sources do not settle it

evidence.supports: tower at Hurricane Mills, Humphreys County, 712 feet, standing, code FD1633
the extant list is dated March 26, 2014
evidence.quote: Extant Tennessee Fire Towers as of March 26, 2014

evidence.supports: the study covers Division of Forestry fire lookout towers
evidence.quote: The TDF was responsible for the construction of 208 fire lookout towers

notes_for_editor: Status conflict. tnlandforms marks the tower standing with code FD1633; the 2014 Division of Forestry extant list has no Humphreys County entry. Proposed status correction is for human review. Unverified lead, not cited: a search snippet mentioned a registry entry for a 97.5 m antenna structure in Hurricane Mills, registered 2011; the page returned 403 and was not read, so it is not used. The record coordinates are about 2.5 km from the community's coordinates, so check the point. No history, owner, staffing or access found.
